digest.component_or_area: reconciler vendor-adapter seam / jira_family sub-seam and its ADR record
propositions: A new ADR 0055 must amend (not replace) ADR 0035's reconciler-vendor-adapter-seam, recording the two-level jira_family sub-seam, its RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts, the shared-jira provenance decision, the pycontribs/jira extra-gated dependency, and the Data Center read-only horizon of 28 March 2029.

ADR 0035's claim that the contract suite certifies a backend is only conditional: the TicketTransport port declares six members while the core reaches for twenty-one, twelve are absent from the DC transport, and a DC write pass crashed on set_entity_property while isinstance, the contract suite, and 1636 unit tests were all green.

RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code (only two test helpers), so the ADR must present instance-based deployment distinction as intended design with the gap named and ticketed, not as existing reality.

All stale ADR 0035 statements that the first real second backend is out of scope must be corrected across every site (layout diagram, prose, Decision item, Consequences, and a section-(c) annotation), since Jira Data Center landed ahead of the reserved GitHub adapter epic.

docs/user-guide.md must document DC backend selection, the jira-datacenter extra, least-privilege PAT scoping, allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses, and the documented commands must be executed against the live DC harness.

The documented setup commands are verified by parsing config out of the guide at runtime and running against a real Jira Data Center instance, which also caught a defect where a config-only JIRA_PAT fell back to anonymous access instead of erroring.
